init_LightningAttentionBackend: initialize the LightningAttentionBackend with a ModelRunner for linear attention inference
run_forward_extend: run the forward extend pass for linear attention with q, k, v tensors and a RadixAttention layer
run_forward_decode: run the forward decode pass for linear attention with q, k, v tensors and a RadixAttention layer
init_forward_metadata: initialize forward metadata from a ForwardBatch for mixed prefill and decode modes
build_slope_tensor: build a slope tensor for positional encoding given the number of attention heads and hidden layers
